Shortage Request Service (send us the shortfall)

Subcontract Stock Service (material at the vendor)
Virtual Location Service (Loss, In Transit, vendor bins)
Pallet Labels (arrival label, relabel after use)
Dieline Engine (TMDieline)
items.purpose: Draws the flat dieline of a product type from its dimensions, live while Sales types the size.

items.name: Imposition Engine
items.purpose: Finds how many pieces (UP) fit on a plano sheet and which layout wastes the least paper.

items.name: Spec Engine (BOP · BOM · Ink)
items.purpose: Builds the production specification of a part: process steps, materials and ink configuration.

items.name: Usage Rate Engine
items.purpose: Learns material usage rates and waste percentages from real production data and proposes new values for the BOP rules.

items.name: Routing Template Engine
items.purpose: Checks the order of process steps and turns a routing template into ready steps with a suggested machine.

items.name: Costing Engine (Pro-Cost)
items.purpose: Calculates the cost price (HPP) of every part and the selling price per quantity tier of an inquiry.

items.name: Reverse Costing
items.purpose: Turns a stand-alone (instant) costing into an integrated one by creating the documents that normally come before it.

items.name: Flow Engine (Approval)
items.purpose: Moves a document through its approval steps, the same way for every module.

items.name: CPDEL Engine (Customer Plan Delivery)
items.purpose: Creates the delivery schedule when a Customer Order is confirmed.

items.name: CPDEL Two Promises
items.purpose: Keeps the promise to the customer (delivery slot) and the promise of production (ready date) in line.

items.name: Material Planning Engine (MPS · MRP · Booking)
items.purpose: Works out which materials every order needs, books stock for it and shows what is short.

items.name: Booking Maintenance (hold and stale booking)
items.purpose: Frees reservations nobody uses: a Hold that has expired, and a Confirmed booking that never became a work order.

items.name: Warehouse Stock (bins, capacity, dead stock)
items.purpose: Tells what is in every bin, how full the bin is by weight and by volume, when the goods arrived, and which stock is dead or expired. One source for the Warehouse Map, transfers, labels and tracking.

items.name: Stock Document Posting (stock card order)
items.purpose: Writes a stock document (Stock In, Out, Return, Adjustment, goods receipt and its reversal) to the stock card in document-date order and keeps every later balance right.

items.name: Stock Transfer Posting
items.purpose: Moves stock from one bin to another, in the same warehouse or between warehouses, with or without approval, and can take the move back.

items.name: Batch Service (batch master and quality status)
items.purpose: The one door for creating batches and changing their quality status. Screens, receiving, backfill and QC all call it; nothing writes the batch table directly.

items.name: Batch Backfill (batches from old lot data)
items.purpose: Turns the lot numbers already in stock cards and pallets into batches and links the old rows to them. Safe to run twice; a check run only counts.

items.name: Putaway Planner (suggests a bin)
items.purpose: Suggests the bins where a received pallet may be put away, best first. The warehouse officer confirms by scanning; the planner never moves stock.

items.name: Warehouse Task Service (putaway tasks)
items.purpose: Keeps the list of putaway tasks for pallets that wait in a receiving or QC Hold area and moves the pallet when the officer scans it and its bin.

items.name: Pick Allocator (which pallet to take)
items.purpose: For one material, chooses the pallets, batches and bins that may be taken and in which order. The warehouse officer confirms by scanning.

items.name: Pick List Service
items.purpose: Makes a pick list per Work Order from its confirmed booking, lets the officer scan pallets and bins, and issues the material to the work order when all lines are picked.

items.name: QC Sampling Service (sampling plan)
items.purpose: Works out how a received lot is checked: the risk class of the item, how tight the checks are for this supplier, and the sample size for the lot.

items.name: QC Decision Service
items.purpose: The one door for a quality decision on a batch: sampling at the dock, first article at the press, a later usage decision, or a deviation. Each decision changes the batch status and is kept.

items.name: QC Trace Service (forward trace of a rejected batch)
items.purpose: Finds where a rejected batch went: the issue documents, the work orders, and the orders or deliveries made from it; holds those work orders and opens one supplier claim.

items.name: Stock Reversal Service (cancel a posted stock document)
items.purpose: Cancels a posted stock document without editing or deleting it: a reversing document with the opposite direction is posted through the normal path.

items.name: Count Task Service (cycle count)
items.purpose: Makes count tasks for storage areas that are due, locks their bins while counting, and turns the difference into a Stock Opname document.

items.name: Subcontract Stock Service (material at the vendor)
items.purpose: Sends raw material to a subcontractor against a Subcontract PO and keeps the material at the vendor as our own stock until it is used or comes back.

items.name: Customer Material Service (consignment)
items.purpose: Turns the material a customer brings (a Customer receipt with a raw material item) into stock owned by that customer, kept in a consignment bin, without value and without journal.

items.name: Virtual Location Service (Loss, In Transit, vendor bins)
items.purpose: Makes the places where stock exists in the books but not on the warehouse floor: Loss, In Transit and one bin per subcontractor. Created when needed, never twice.

items.name: Pallet Labels (arrival label, relabel after use)
items.purpose: Keeps one label per pallet and tells which stock still needs a pallet label: goods that arrived without one, and pallets whose label no longer matches because stock was used.

items.name: Stock Period Ledger
items.purpose: Works out the stock of a period for the reports: opening balance, movements and closing balance of every item, in quantity and value, for all stock classes.

items.name: Urgent Receipt Service
items.purpose: Lets a receipt line be posted before the quality result and go straight to production (URGENT), while sampling runs in parallel and the batch stays Conditional.

items.name: Shortage Detector (short delivery found late)
items.purpose: Compares the material issued to a work order with its good output plus standard waste and suspects a short delivery when material is missing.

items.name: Shortage Request Service (send us the shortfall)
items.purpose: Follows a short delivery from suspicion to settlement: recount, confirm, ask the supplier, subcontractor or customer to send the shortfall, and close or refuse.

items.name: Purchase Quotation Matcher
items.purpose: Matches the text of a supplier quotation file to the supplier master and to the requisition lines.

items.name: Work Order Generation
items.purpose: Creates the Work Orders when a delivery line is posted to Production.

items.name: PDR Engine (Scheduling)
items.purpose: Decides which job a machine should run next and plans a Work Order backwards from its due date.

items.name: Scheduling Rule Engine
items.purpose: Applies the batching and sequencing rules kept as data, not as code.

items.name: Hot Job Option Generator
items.purpose: When an urgent job must be inserted, proposes up to three ways to do it with their measured impact.

items.name: Speed Target Engine
items.purpose: Proposes the target speed of every machine and of every process x machine pair.

items.name: PPIC Auto-Planner
items.purpose: Prepares a Draft plan for every open Work Order: gates, estimates, schedule and the list of what needs a person. Nothing becomes the real schedule until the officer confirms.

items.name: Schedule Solver (finite capacity)
items.purpose: Pure calculation: ranks the jobs and places each operation on the machine that finishes it earliest, with setup, wait and calendar included.

items.name: Setup Time Engine
items.purpose: Setup minutes and extra waste between two jobs on a machine: base setup plus every change (colour, ink type, substrate, size, plate, die) plus tool mounting.

items.name: Readiness Gates
items.purpose: Marks every operation Ready, Waiting (with a date) or Blocked (with a reason) for material, tooling and artwork.

items.name: Work Order Enrichment
items.purpose: Completes a new Work Order with what scheduling must know: process ids, the machines that can run each step, target per hour, waste, spoilage and setup.

items.name: Plan Confirm and Change
items.purpose: The officer side of the plan: Confirm makes the Draft the real schedule and locks the next shifts; priority and drag changes go into a new Draft with their impact shown first.

items.name: Operator Timer
items.purpose: Play, Pause and Stop at the machine: records real setup, run and pause time and the quantities of each job.

items.name: Learning Engine (changeover)
items.purpose: Corrects the Assumed changeover minutes from the setup times operators really needed, in small logged steps that can be put back.

items.name: Preventive Plan Engine
items.purpose: Works out when each preventive plan is next due and opens the Draft preventive orders on time.

items.name: Maintenance Order Lifecycle
items.purpose: Moves a Maintenance Order (PMO, BMO, IMO) from Draft to Closed and keeps the machine status and downtime log true.

items.name: Maintenance Request Engine
items.purpose: Turns a problem report into a Breakdown Maintenance Order, and suggests how urgent it is.

items.name: Maintenance Spare Part Supply
items.purpose: Shows spare part stock on an order, issues the parts from the warehouse, and drafts a purchase requisition for what is short.

items.name: Maintenance KPI
items.purpose: Computes the Dashboard and report figures: availability, MTBF, MTTR, PM compliance, planned work, backlog, downtime and cost.

items.name: Maintenance Machine Hold (Scheduling)
items.purpose: Tells Scheduling when a machine belongs to Maintenance, so production is never planned into those hours.

items.name: Tax Engine
items.purpose: Builds the monthly tax register (VAT, income tax 21 and 23), posts payments and reconciles with the ledger.

items.name: Payroll Engine
items.purpose: Calculates the payslips of a period from attendance and takes the run through verification, payment and closing.

items.name: Assistant Engine (offline)
items.purpose: Answers a question typed by the user without sending anything outside the company.
